flagged.evidence: The Statement covers “Two balanced Heegaard diagrams of the same marked sutured manifold” without a connectedness condition. Proof 1.1 says “Both negative and positive marked boundary surfaces are assumed connected.” The current proof therefore does not establish the Statement for balanced diagrams with disconnected marked boundary surfaces.

The Statement asserts the integral disk-complex and moduli-space results without a choice assumption. Fact [F5] places the cited framework “in the classical full-Choice setting of F4,” and Proof 3.16 says a Countable-Choice application needs separate justification. The Statement omits a hypothesis required by its cited analytic input.

The Statement covers a separating product annulus with connected R+ and R−. The current definition of product annulus requires only a decomposing annulus with one boundary circle in each of R+ and R−; it does not require essentiality. But Proof 3.1 begins “For an essential separating product annulus,” and [F2] supplies only the essential-annulus operation. Thus the unqualified Statement includes nonessential cases not covered by this proof or supplier.
